parsed.main_gap: A sign error in the lower-inequality expansion; correcting it makes the subsequent estimate and proof valid.

errors.description: The expansion has the sign reversed: it equals (t-y)^2+4(t+c)(c-b), not with (b-c). The inequality (5) follows from the corrected formula, so this is a straightforwardly repairable algebraic error.

parsed.notes: Apart from this sign typo, the iterate argument, nonnegativity of displacement, quadratic estimate, partition argument, and converse correctly establish exactly f(x)=x+C for C≥0.
